paper_title: Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time   Scaling
caption: Comparison between the performance of smaller LLMs compute-optimal TTS and that of larger LLMs CoT on MATH-500 and AIME24. (a) & (d) Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct surpasses Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct and GPT-4o on MATH-500 and AIME24; (b) & (e) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B outperforms o1-preview on MATH-500 and AIME24, and surpasses o1-mini on MATH-500; (c) & (f) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B beats o1 on MATH-500 and AIME24, and exceeds DeepSeek-R1 on AIME24.
model_annotation:
The figure presents a comparative bar chart illustrating the performance of various large language models (LLMs) on two mathematical reasoning benchmarks: MATH-500 and AIME24. The chart is divided into six subplots labeled (a) through (f), with each subplot comparing different model configurations under two inference strategies: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and Test-Time Scaling (TTS). The legend at the top identifies the models and their corresponding visual patterns: CoT (white with black outline), TTS (blue diagonal stripes), Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct (blue diagonal stripes), Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct (green), o1-mini (pink), DeepSeek-R1 (beige), o1 (gray), GPT-4o (purple with white swirl), DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B (red diagonal stripes), and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B (orange diagonal stripes). 

On the left side, under the MATH-500 benchmark, subplot (a) shows Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct achieving 78.2 (TTS) versus Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct at 71.4 (CoT) and GPT-4o at 74.6 (CoT), with the horizontal axis labeled "3B", "unk", and "405B" respectively. Subplot (b) compares DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B (91.6, TTS) with o1-preview (85.5, CoT) and o1-mini (90.0, CoT), with axis labels "1.5B", "unk", "unk". Subplot (c) shows DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B (95.2, TTS) surpassing DeepSeek-R1 (97.3, CoT) and o1 (94.8, CoT), with axis labels "671B", "7B", "unk". The vertical axis for MATH-500 ranges from 65 to 100 with a linear scale and tick marks every 5 units.

On the right side, under the AIME24 benchmark, subplot (d) shows Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct (30.0, TTS) outperforming Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct (23.3, CoT) and GPT-4o (9.3, CoT), with axis labels "3B", "405B", "unk". Subplot (e) compares DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B (63.3, TTS) with o1-preview (44.6, CoT) and o1-mini (63.6, CoT), with axis labels "unk", "1.5B", "unk". Subplot (f) shows DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B (83.3, TTS) exceeding DeepSeek-R1 (79.8, CoT) and o1 (79.2, CoT), with axis labels "7B", "671B", "unk". The vertical axis for AIME24 ranges from 0 to 90 with a linear scale and tick marks every 10 units. Each bar is labeled with its exact performance score, and model icons (e.g., swirl for GPT-4o, infinity symbol for Llama) are embedded in the bars to indicate the model. The bars are grouped by model size or type, and the order of bars within each group follows the model labels on the horizontal axis, which are not always numerically sorted but reflect the model configuration.
